name: Smith Machine Standing Shoulder Press
steps: Face the bar at collarbone height and take an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Bring your elbows just forward of the bar, brace your trunk and release the hooks.
Press the bar straight overhead along the guide rails until your arms are extended without harshly locking your elbows.
Lower the bar slowly back to upper-chest height under strict control.
tips: Stand close enough to the bar so it glides neatly past your nose without forcing you to lean backward.
Keep your ribs tucked down instead of arching your lower back at the top.
